payload.design: 654 training hosts, outer resamples r = 0-29 x seeds 0-4 (5-seed ensembles); S and D from results/analysis/precision_eval_long.parquet (v2), D* from results/dretrain_v2

draws.difference_host_cluster_paired: host weights V of the host-cluster scheme (818 hosts, 2000, 20261008) shared by both halves, replicate = mean over 10-29 of the slot values minus mean over 0-9 (hosts tested in both halves move together)
draws.difference_independent_hier: replicate (10-29, HierDraws.make([164] * 20, 2000, 20261009)) minus replicate (0-9, HierDraws.make([164] * 10, 2000, 20261008)); the two halves treated as independent designs, a separate seed so the two generator streams are not aligned

design_split.note: r0_9_seeds0_2 is the learning-curve subset; its S and D come from precision_eval_long (the learning-curve records use staging_eval_long, compared in reproduction)

estimator.bonferroni: two-sided 1 - 0.05/6: percentiles 0.4167 and 99.5833 of the same replicates
estimator.common: seed-ensemble mean per (model, r, site); each quantity is a ratio of per-host sums; slot value = ratio of the weighted sums of one resample; replicate = mean over 30 slots; point = mean over resamples of the per-resample value (R: ratio of point MAEs); paired differences per replicate; ci95 = 2.5/97.5 percentiles, U (upper_one_sided_95) = 95th percentile, boot_sd ddof 1
estimator.crossed: rng = default_rng(20261008); V = rng.multinomial(818, uniform, size=2000) (identical to the host scheme's V), then pick = rng.integers(0, 30, size=(2000, 30)); slot k = resample pick[b, k] with host weights V[b, .]; a site enters slot k with multiplicity V[b, host] when its resample is drawn into the slot and its host is drawn, and is absent otherwise
estimator.hier: HierDraws.make([164] * 30, 2000, 20261008): per slot a resample with replacement, then its 164 test hosts with replacement, independently per slot (a host tested in six resamples is redrawn six times independently)
estimator.host: host-cluster: V = default_rng(20261008).multinomial(818, uniform, size=n_boot) over the 818 distinct test hosts sorted by host_id; all 30 resamples kept, every site of host h in resample r weighted V[b, h], so a drawn host carries all its appearances; 2000 replicates (20000 for A* and A, same generator seed)

payload.label: intervals of the descriptor advantage with the 818 distinct test hosts as the sampling unit (host-cluster and crossed bootstraps) next to the paper's HierDraws; Bonferroni intervals over six claims; resample halves of the 654-host design; within-host Spearman on 30 x 5

overlap.note: 654 training hosts + 164 test hosts = 818 distinct hosts: the training pool of a resample is the complement of its test hosts

design_split_r0_9_seeds0_2.reference: results/derived_dstar/dstar_gaps.json payload.sweep_10x3.654 (MAE of S, D, D*; S - D, S - D*: A, ci95, U); draws identical (analysis/staging_analysis.make_draws)

dstar_gaps.reference: results/derived_dstar/dstar_gaps.json payload.headline_654_30x5.654 (MAE of S, D, D*; S - D*, S - D, D - D*: A, ci95, U, boot_sd)

spearman_10x3.reference: results/derived_dstar/dstar_extras.json payload.spearman (S, D, D*, S - D*, D - D*, S - D; mean, ci95, n_hosts)

sign_convention.design_split_difference: value on resamples 10-29 minus value on resamples 0-9
sign_convention.relative_reduction: A*/MAE_S (fraction of the structure-only error removed by the descriptors)
sign_convention.selection_D_minus_S: hit fraction of D minus that of S
sign_convention.selection_Dstar_minus_S: hit fraction of D* minus that of S (positive = D* picks the lowest site more often)
sign_convention.spearman: S_minus_Dstar etc.: Spearman of the first minus the second (negative = D* orders sites better)
sign_convention.within_host_A_star: within-host residual MAE of S minus that of D* (positive = D* ranks sites better)

definitions.design_30x5_hier: per resample, per test host with >= 3 tested sites, Spearman (average ranks; undefined when constant, excluded) of the 5-seed-ensemble prediction and the DFT target; per-resample value = mean over eligible hosts; point = mean over 30 resamples; HierDraws.make([164] * 30, 2000, 20261008), slot value = weighted mean of host correlations; differences per host (both defined) then the same averaging
definitions.stored_10x3: analysis/within_host_breakdown.py: prediction per site averaged over the resamples that tested it (3-seed ensembles, r 0-9), one Spearman per host over all its sites, mean over hosts, host-cluster bootstrap SeedSequence([20261012, k = 55]); recomputed here from results/v2_sweep and D* r 0-9 seeds 0-2
